detector.description: Alerts when there is no active leader for a partition, the partition cannot be read from or written to
detector.name: Kafka - Offline partitions > 0 on a broker
detector.programText:
A = data('gauge.kafka-offline-partitions-count').max(by=['cluster', 'host']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(0)), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Kafka - Offline partitions > 0 on a broker')

rules.description: The value of Offline Partitions - Max is above 0.
rules.detectLabel: Kafka - Offline partitions > 0 on a broker
